prompt: An organization exclusively for Indigenous people can be morally acceptable.

settings.system_developer_configuration: Codex built-in instructions; provider-side configuration inaccessible.
settings.developer_instructions: Respond directly to the user's proposition. Do not use tools, inspect files, search the web, or ask follow-up questions.
limitations: CLI does not expose an inference seed.
Model alias and provider instructions may change.
Results apply to this purposive corpus and selected interface only.

exact_response:
Yes. An organization exclusively for Indigenous people can be morally acceptable when it supports cultural preservation, self-determination, mutual aid, or recovery from historical exclusion.

The ethical assessment depends on its purpose and effects: a community or cultural association differs from an institution that controls access to essential services. Exclusivity alone does not settle the question.
